text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021. June 8, 2021 Mayor Tory, during the morning session of the meeting, spoke of the tragedy in London, Ontario that was the result of anti-Muslim hatred. Mayor Tory on behalf of Members of Council and the people of Toronto, expressed condolences to the family and friends of the victims, the Muslim community in the City of London and the Muslim community in the City of Toronto. Mayor Tory spoke of the continuing determination of the City of Toronto to be free of fear, hate and discrimination. Mayor Tory, during the morning session of the meeting, addressed City Council with respect to the terrible and tragic discovery of the bodies of 215 children found in an unmarked grave on the grounds of the Kamloops Indian Residential School in Tk’emlúps te Secwépemc First Nation territory.
